_comment: Per-asset settings for tools/run_chunk_pass.py. Only assets whose measured facet_evenness sits far above Suma's 0.03-0.20 band need an entry; hand-authored props and kit assets are already in language. See docs/STYLE_CHUNK_PASS.md.

prop_fir.note: Tall, thin, many wafer tiers. Squat it hard and hide the spiky root star under the canopy. Its visible stem is canopy geometry, not the 107-face Trunk mesh, so recolour it by radius.

prop_stone_pine.note: Already broad, so widen gently; the trunk is the heavy read here.

prop_leafy_bush.note: Trunk is 18 faces and barely visible; all the work is canopy mass.

prop_shrooms.note: Arrived as droopy hooked wizard hats. The dome stage conforms each cap to a round Garden Galaxy silhouette; widen/squash are left alone because the dome already sets cap proportions.
